notes.title: Chronicles of the Wolf – 🛠 Patch Notes 📝
notes.content: [p]Greetings Hunters,[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you all for the incredible support following the launch of [i]Chronicles of the Wolf[/i]! [/p][p] [/p][p]We’ve been listening carefully to all the feedback and as a result we have just released our [b]first[/b] post-launch patch. [/p][p] [/p][p]Below are the full patch notes including some quality of life fixes that should help smooth out your journey across Gévaudan.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]🛠 Patch Notes Summary[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Keyboard controls are now working properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard prompts are functioning correctly during tutorials.[/p][/*][*][p]The ESC key now opens the in-game menu.[/p][/*][*][p]In the Spanish version, the word [b]“quitar”[/b] has been replaced with [b]“salir.”[/b][/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Hospital level[/b], only one furnace remains operational to help players with FPS issues progress.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Killer Plant[/b] enemy stats have been corrected in the Monster Chart.[/p][/*][*][p]Exiting the [b]Relics[/b] section now properly returns you to the correct menu line.[/p][/*][*][p]The text in front of the first [b]save statue[/b] has been updated to clearly indicate that you must press [b]UP[/b] in front of the statue.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Chronicles Master[/b] trophy has been restored. For players who had unlocked everything except this trophy before the patch, simply enter the game and load a save file where you have defeated the Beast a second time — the trophy will pop.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Gauntlet[/b] behind the third door in [b]Apcher Castle[/b] has been simplified. There is now always a platform underneath for “leap of faith”-style jumps.[/p][/*][*][p]Spelling mistakes have been corrected in one of the endings and in the credit roll.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]💡 Recommendations:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We suggest players check whether their [b]antivirus[/b] is causing long loading times — this is often the case.[/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes, [b]Steam Input[/b] needs to be manually enabled or disabled to resolve controller issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Regarding [b]recordings[/b] on platforms like Twitch: Recording works perfectly in FULL SCREEN mode. In windowed mode, parts of the game that open in a separate window may not be captured correctly. Players need to configure their setup to record both windows.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for all your support and for joining us on this journey. Just so you know, we’re still listening, updating and improving the experience so, please keep your eyes peeled![/p][p] [/p][p][i]The Chronicles of the Wolf Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Chronicles of the Wolf: A Dark Tale Inspired by History & Mystery
notes.content:
Greetings, Hunters,

It's not too long to go until the [i][b]19th June 2025[/b][/i], when [b][i]Chronicles of the Wolf [/i][/b]officially launches on Steam. To prepare you for this epic adventure, it would only be fitting to give a brief insight into the bloody history that inspired the journey you will undertake with Mateo Lombardo.

[i]Chronicles of the Wolf[/i] teleports you into a world where myth bleeds into reality. The immersive metroidvania gameplay is weaved with two powerful strands of real-world lore: the secretive Rose Cross Order and the chilling legend of the [i]Beast of Gévaudan[/i].

[h3]🐺 The Beast of Gévaudan: Real-World Horror[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/a3716ff468c7b97e3a98da2f2f40e88499291384.png[/img]
Between 1764 and 1767, rural France was gripped by terror. A monstrous creature stalked the countryside, killing over 100 people. It was no ordinary wolf. Survivors described it as massive, unnatural with reddish fur and an almost human-like posture. Today, it’s remembered as the [i]Beast of Gévaudan[/i], a historical mystery that is still prominent in modern pop-culture and folklore across the globe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/dedee8f2a2f69e9b2803c9a8e4ff15f3c87012e6.gif[/img]

In the game, the Beast is more than a myth; it is your nightmare, stalking you as you progress. You will always be thinking, [i]"who is hunting who?"[/i] Each boss fight, environmental hazard and haunting ruin you encounter builds toward a showdown with this legendary terror. Will you face it with courage or, succumb to it's hunger like it's many victims?

[h3]🎮 Where History Meets Gameplay[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/b5299dfb0f66931e7496d2ab84e741397050ccc6.jpg[/img]
[i]Chronicles of the Wolf[/i] doesn't just reference history, it builds its gameplay around it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/2b671c352cb65e826dd0cedf55b275a83ad13289.jpg[/img]
🏰 Traverse an interconnected world based on 18th-century France, from ruined cathedrals to dense, cursed forests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/f223cdc6b323dce6e2bf48c6e5d2b01d69c179e7.jpg[/img]
🌒 Navigate an ever-changing world where light fades and new threats rise with the dark.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/2aa51f6891fcf545e32156c256ddecdab009d1c0.jpg[/img]
⚔️ Battle through brutal boss encounters, each one a twisted reflection of regional folklore and inner corruption.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/faaf7760943de78e4cd20feae63c2f96339e9f15.jpg[/img]
✨ Harness the teachings of the Rose Cross, unlocking powerful relics, combat upgrades and hidden paths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/fa4c1cb0011179d9b774c2eea31ad027bb96e55d.jpg[/img]
📖 Uncover lore and illustrated cutscenes told through the voice of Robert Belgrade ([i]Castlevania: Symphony of the Night, Tekken[/i] and [i]Soul Blade[/i]).

[h3]🔍 Ready to Explore the Truth?[/h3]

With pixel-perfect art, haunting music and a story that blends fact and fiction, [i]Chronicles of the Wolf[/i] is more than a metroidvania – it's an invitation into a forgotten world.

Will you uncover the truth behind the Beast? Or will you become another name lost to the shadows?

🎮 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2371890/Chronicles_of_the_Wolf/]Play the free demo now and begin your journey[/url]. 

👁️ Sign up to Learn More: https://bit.ly/4dwqdRe

notes.title: Chronicles of the Wolf Coming Summer 2025
notes.content:
[h2]The Hunt Begins – Chronicles of the Wolf lands a publisher in PQube![/h2]
 
The Beast is real… and it’s waiting for you.
 
PQube and PixelHeart are thrilled to announce Chronicles of the Wolf, a dark and thrilling action-adventure developed by Migami Games, launching Summer 2025.

[previewyoutube=q0-3i-pM7j4;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Step into the boots of Mateo Lombardo, the last apprentice of the Rose Cross Order, as he embarks on a perilous quest to hunt the legendary Beast of Gévaudan. Explore vast, interconnected castles, battle brutal bosses, and uncover the secrets lurking in the shadows. Featuring a special guest appearance by Bloodless from Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night and narration by Robert Belgrade (Castlevania: Symphony of the Night), this is a must-play for fans of dark, atmospheric adventures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359263/dedee8f2a2f69e9b2803c9a8e4ff15f3c87012e6.gif[/img]
